Selected work

Organic Maps

Cycling lines on a real map

A cyclist sharing a lane with cars has a different ride from one behind a curb. The released cycling layer shows routes in purple. My proposal gives each kind of infrastructure its own line and puts it on the corresponding side of the road.

  • Shared travel lane
  • Painted bike lane
  • Physically separated track
Ride the island routeRead PR #12692

Downtown Vancouver, at the same center and zoom in the Android Emulator. Release uses the regional download. PR build 09bb2672 uses a Vancouver test map. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

Environmental monitoring

Peak HydroMet

As sole developer, I built the station firmware, telemetry pipeline, and dashboard widgets. An nRF52840 reads Davis instruments over RS-485, then sends a common JSON format over LoRaWAN or cellular.

Follow a weather reading

Web performance

SharedLens

I built a photo and video gallery used at five weddings with more than 100 guests. Its loader prioritizes thumbnails near the viewport and limits requests to four at a time. Multipart S3 uploads report progress on large files.

Contributions in the wild

On Feeder, I added seekable read-aloud playback, article translation, and suggestions for discovering publications. My desktop contributions include clipboard behavior on GNOME, model organization in Newelle, and build tooling for whisper.cpp.

Teaching & communication
